# Francisco de Vitoria

*1483 – 1546 · Spanish · [Scholasticism](../movements/scholasticism.md)*

Dominican theologian and leading figure of the School of Salamanca, who recognized the Indigenous peoples' rightful sovereignty over their lands and laid the foundations of a law of nations binding among all peoples.
